_note: Domain packs: which specialist agents to look for per phase (exact agent names, '*' wildcard allowed), and the checklist AgentShip injects into planning and review whether or not a specialist is installed. Agent names match the VoltAgent collection (github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents) and any agent with the same name in the project, user or another plugin. Minimum risk per domain lives in default-policies.json.

checklist: Untrusted input is validated and encoded at every boundary
No secrets in code, logs or error messages
Least privilege for new permissions, tokens and service accounts
Dependencies added are pinned and come from trusted sources
Every new path checks authorization on the server side
Role and permission changes cannot escalate privileges
Session and token lifetimes, revocation and rotation are handled
Tests cover the denied cases, not only the allowed ones

payments.description: Payment providers, money movement, refunds, payouts
checklist: Amounts use integer minor units or decimals, never floats
Operations are idempotent (idempotency keys, retries do not double charge)
Webhook signatures are verified and replays rejected
Every state change on money is auditable and reversible by a compensating entry

accounting.description: Ledgers, journal entries, invoicing, taxes, financial reports
checklist: Double entry: every journal entry balances (debits = credits)
Amounts and currency: decimal arithmetic, explicit rounding rule, currency stored with the amount
Posted entries are immutable; corrections are reversing entries
Closed periods cannot be modified
Tax rules and rates are data, with effective dates
Reports reconcile with the ledger totals

compliance.description: Personal data, GDPR/CCPA, HIPAA, audit requirements
checklist: Personal data collected is the minimum needed and has a retention rule
Personal data is not logged or sent to third parties without a basis
Access to sensitive records is audited

data-migrations.description: Schema changes, data backfills, database migrations
checklist: Migration is reversible or has a tested rollback / backup
Backfills run in batches and are idempotent
Old and new code can run against the schema during deploy
Locks and long-running statements on large tables are avoided

infrastructure.description: CI/CD, cloud resources, containers, deploy configuration
checklist: Changes are declared as code and reviewed, not applied by hand
Rollback path exists and is documented
No production credentials or endpoints in the change
